title: 关节驱动板的实时任务调度
title_en: Real-time task scheduling on the joint drive board
summary: 电流环 20 kHz、速度环、EtherCAT 通信、位置环、诊断、日志 6 个任务排在关节驱动板的一颗 MCU 上：比较前后台大循环、固定优先级、最早截止期优先，选固定优先级（截止期单调）；手算利用率、Liu–Layland 界和精确响应时间（含中断延迟、上下文切换、共享缓冲阻塞），发现电流环超时、改成无锁双缓冲；离散事件调度仿真 1 000 个超周期对照；软件公司发布流水线做 20 次构建，发布门禁量最坏中断延迟。
summary_en: Six tasks (20 kHz current loop, speed loop, EtherCAT, position loop, diagnostics, logging) on the joint drive board's MCU: super-loop, fixed priority and EDF compared, fixed priority (deadline monotonic) chosen; utilization, Liu–Layland bound and exact response-time analysis (interrupt latency, context switches, blocking on a shared buffer) show the current loop missing its deadline, fixed with a lock-free double buffer; a discrete-event scheduling simulation over 1,000 hyperperiods cross-checks; 20 release builds through the software company's pipeline, worst-case interrupt latency measured at the release gate.
honest: 示例设计：经计算和仿真校核，没有实物试制；数值为示例值。
honest_en: Example design: checked by calculation and simulation, not built and tested; all values are examples.

steps.title: 任务书
steps.summary: 一颗 200 MHz MCU 上 6 个硬实时任务，电流环 20 kHz、截止期 25 μs；中断延迟 ≤ 8 μs。
steps.summary_en: Six hard real-time tasks on one 200 MHz MCU; 20 kHz current loop with a 25 μs deadline; interrupt latency ≤ 8 μs.

steps.title: 方案
steps.summary: 选固定优先级（截止期单调）+ 优先级天花板；利用率 78.0 % 超过 Liu–Layland 界 73.5 %，要精确分析。
steps.summary_en: Fixed priority (deadline monotonic) with priority ceiling; utilization 78.0 % exceeds the Liu–Layland bound 73.5 %, so exact analysis is needed.

steps.title: 计算
steps.summary: 初稿电流环 R = 29.6 μs > 25 μs（被共享缓冲挡住）；改无锁双缓冲后 23.6 μs，6 个任务全部满足截止期。
steps.summary_en: Draft current loop R = 29.6 μs > 25 μs (blocked on the shared buffer); with a lock-free double buffer 23.6 μs, all six tasks meet their deadlines.

steps.title: 仿真
steps.summary: 1000 个超周期：仿真最坏都不超过分析值（电流环 21.9 / 23.6 μs），0 次错过；初稿错过 74 次；日志超时 3 倍不连累别人。
steps.summary_en: 1000 hyperperiods: simulated worst cases never exceed the analysis (current loop 21.9 / 23.6 μs), 0 misses; the draft missed 74 times; a 3× logging overrun affects no other task.

steps.title: 三维与图纸
steps.summary: 6 个任务 P1–P6；电流环与速度环之间无锁双缓冲；其余共享数据用优先级天花板（P2）；调度表写进板级配置。
steps.summary_en: Six tasks P1–P6; lock-free double buffer between the current and speed loops; other shared data under priority ceiling (P2); schedule table in the board configuration.

steps.title: 工艺
steps.summary: 发布流水线 7 道：合并评审 → 编译单元测试 → 集成测试 → 硬件在环（量中断延迟）→ 安全扫描 → 发布门禁 → 签名发布。
steps.summary_en: 7-step release pipeline: review, build & unit test, integration test, HIL (interrupt latency), security scan, release gate, sign & publish.

steps.title: 制造
steps.summary: 20 次构建：最坏中断延迟最大 6.73 μs（≤ 8），不合格 0，最低 Cpk 2.06；实测延迟下电流环 R = 22.3 μs。
steps.summary_en: 20 builds: worst interrupt latency at most 6.73 μs (≤ 8); 0 failures, lowest Cpk 2.06; current loop R = 22.3 μs with the measured latency.

steps.title: 总结
steps.summary: 14 / 14 项校核通过；固定优先级、电流环无锁双缓冲，R = 23.6 μs ≤ 25 μs。
steps.summary_en: 14 / 14 checks pass; fixed priority, lock-free current loop, R = 23.6 μs ≤ 25 μs.
